title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Calculation of the Exterior Permanent-Work Payment
content:
# Calculation of the Exterior Permanent-Work Payment

Claims Finance computation note for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, permanent work on exterior service lines.

## The calculation

The exterior permanent-work payment is figured once, on the day it is booked and from the plan's records as they stand that day; periods said to run to the request date end on the service request's request date. The exterior permanent-work payment is the exterior occurrence benefit left open on the service request: the plan's occurrence cap for the line (the water line occurrence cap for a water service line, the sewer line occurrence cap for a sewer lateral or a septic line, the electrical line occurrence cap for an electrical service line, the gas line occurrence cap for a gas service line) less every amount already authorized on the service request, net of reversals, never below zero. The exterior permanent-work payment is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## The cap for the line

| Line on the service request | Occurrence cap (a figure of the plan held) |
|---|---|
| exterior water service line | water line occurrence cap |
| sewer lateral | sewer line occurrence cap |
| septic line | sewer line occurrence cap |
| exterior electrical service line | electrical line occurrence cap |
| exterior gas service line | gas line occurrence cap |

## What counts as already authorized

Every authorization on the service request in the plan's claim history counts, whatever it is for: temporary repairs, section repairs and every kind of allowance. Reversals of authorizations on the request are taken off before the amount is set against the cap.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, not plan values)

Assume a water line occurrence cap of $9000.00.

| Already authorized on the request | Reversed | Exterior permanent-work payment |
|---|---|---|
| nothing | nothing | $9000.00 |
| $450.00 temporary repair, $2000.00 allowance, $200.00 allowance | nothing | $6350.00 |
| $450.00 temporary repair, $2000.00 allowance | $450.00 | $7000.00 |
| $9300.00 | nothing | $0.00 |
